svg.aria-label: Trackside architecture: a Tauri 2 window talks over a Unix socket to a Rust core process that owns the PTY sessions; agents run in those PTYs and their tool calls pass through an MCP gateway and an agent hook that apply your policy file and write to a hash-chained audit trail before the call happens.
